_comment: Featured repos, in README order. Star/fork/language come live from the API on every run; the description here overrides the repo's GitHub description. All five of yours currently have none set - worth setting them on GitHub too.

projects.description: An offline-first hotel property management system that runs a real front desk with no cloud dependency. 10+ modules, six staff roles under role-based access control, full Arabic/RTL localisation.
A native restaurant point-of-sale built on Rust and Tauri.
Speech emotion recognition from audio. Roughly 78% accuracy across the evaluation set.
Identified which clinical indicators carry the predictive signal, not just an accuracy number.
A model selection grounded in the metrics that matter when the positive class is rare.
